facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 68°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Mckenzie (4,770 ft) and Hogg Pass (4,800 ft) 43 to 59 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Mckenzie
evidence.detail: left April 6; earlier seasons: June 4 (2023), June 8 (2024), May 29 (2025)

evidence.name: Hogg Pass
evidence.detail: left April 4; earlier seasons: May 19 (2023), May 17 (2024), May 8 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Mckenzie (4,770 ft) and Hogg Pass (4,800 ft).

evidence.name: Mckenzie
evidence.detail: 2.6 in on April 16; earlier seasons: 41.6 in (2023), 39.5 in (2024), 44.3 in (2025)

evidence.name: Hogg Pass
evidence.detail: 1.8 in on April 16; earlier seasons: 25.3 in (2023), 17.3 in (2024), 25.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 19 and May 8, carried from the melt-out dates at Mckenzie (4,770 ft) and Hogg Pass (4,800 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Mckenzie
evidence.detail: melted out April 6, 443 ft below the pass; points to March 20 to May 9

evidence.name: Hogg Pass
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, 413 ft below the pass; points to March 18 to May 6
